silly.en: Don't be silly...! Coming somewhere else to try and face my fears... maybe do a bit of shopping.
silly.zh: 别开玩笑了……！换个地方继续直面我的恐惧……顺便逛逛街。

silly.en: Can I? Can I get behind the wheel? Don't be silly!
silly.zh: 可以吗？我能去坐驾驶位吗？别闹了！

sign.en: Microsoft has signed a deal to buy fusion electricity from a company called Helion by 2028.
sign.zh: 微软已经与一家名为 Helion 的公司签署了一项协议，到2028年购买核聚变电力。

sign.en: Microsoft, for example, signed a deal back in 2024 to bring one of the two reactors at Three Mile Island, in Pennsylvania, back to life.
sign.zh: 例如，微软在2024年签署了一项协议，让宾夕法尼亚州三哩岛的两座反应堆之一重获新生。

site.en: As you may remember, Three Mile Island was the site of a famous partial meltdown back in 1979, but that happened in the other reactor .
site.zh: 你可能还记得，三哩岛在1979年曾发生过一次著名的部分熔毁事故，但那是发生在另一座反应堆上。

site.en: It is in the final stages of opening a nuclear storage site deep underground that will be able to safely store nuclear waste for 100,000 years.
site.zh: 它在地下深处建造的核废料处置库已处于最后开放阶段，该处置库将能安全储存核废料长达10万年。

significant.en: But there has been significant investment and progress in solving this issue.
significant.zh: 但在解决这一问题上，已经有了大量投资和长足进展。
